summary: This repository is a generic Codex workbench for closed-loop harness work. The closed-loop harness is the runtime engine, and `product_build` is only one routed lane.
finish_line: The generic front door routes product_build, harness_design, run_resume, and evaluator_tuning reliably, durable memory stays identity-coherent, and control-plane validations pass without bundling a product surface.

ledger_policy.guidance: Update item statuses and notes without rewriting the full history.

items.label: Make the generic front-door file protocol easy to understand.
done_when: The workflow works in the intended product path.
notes: loop:intent, loop:intake, loop:discover, and operator-facing skills expose the lane-oriented front door; product prepare now writes run-local generated adapter artifacts and indexed ready_to_start markers.

items.label: Make the closed-loop harness engine and external adapter boundary explicit and reusable.
done_when: The workflow works in the intended product path.
notes: Adapter boundaries, evaluator bundles, generated/runtime migration checks, and run-local generated adapter startup are now validated explicitly.

items.label: Keep continuation centered on `patch-request.json`.
done_when: The workflow works in the intended product path.
notes: Continuation and remediation artifacts remain patch-request-led across validated resume flows.

items.label: Preserve enough run context that Codex can resume from files alone.
done_when: The workflow works in the intended product path.
notes: Attached/app-server resume validation passes, prepared sessions now index ready_to_start by run and thread, and app foreground/release gates pass without requiring a local codex binary.

items.label: The workbench should read clearly from its artifacts alone.
done_when: The harness should read clearly from its artifacts alone.
notes: Session-status, session-stream, operator-surface, transport-state, run-local adapter plans, and ready indexes are now projected, while broader docs continue to be tightened.

items.label: The controller should be able to continue across multiple rounds before stopping.
done_when: The controller should be able to continue across multiple rounds before stopping.
notes: resume-autocontinue, attached-resume-smoke, interrupted-round repair, and current-thread continue validations are passing.

items.label: The stop reason should be explicit whether an adapter is attached or not.
done_when: The stop reason should be explicit whether an adapter is attached or not.
notes: stop_reason, session attention, UI visibility, foreground owner, and transport mode surfaces are validated across attached and detached flows.

items.label: The repo structure should not distract from the workbench or its harness engine.
done_when: The repo structure should not distract from the workbench or its harness engine.
notes: Generated product adapter artifacts moved under evals/runs/<run-id>/generated-adapter so repo root no longer receives singleton product-build outputs during prepare.

items.label: Reach the first-version finish line
done_when: The generic front door routes product_build, harness_design, run_resume, and evaluator_tuning reliably, durable memory stays identity-coherent, and control-plane validations pass without bundling a product surface.
notes: validate:app and validate:app-release are green for the Codex app foreground/install path; trusted transport lanes and external adapters remain separate proof surfaces.
